title: My Name Is Noman
blurb: Trapped in the Cyclops's cave, outwit a one-eyed giant with a fake name.

characters.name: Odysseus
characters.description: Clever, cornered, and lying through his teeth.

lines.text: Strangers, who are you? And from what port have you sailed the wet ways?
lines.direction: Loom over them. Squint with your one eye.

lines.text: We are Achaeans, driven by the winds of heaven. We are your suppliants. Respect the gods.
Stranger, you are a fool. We Cyclopes care nothing for Zeus. Tell me your name.
Cyclops, you ask my name. My name is Noman. My father and mother call me Noman.
lines.direction: A sly smile. Hand to chest.

lines.text: Then I will eat Noman last of all his comrades. That shall be your present.
Help! Noman is killing me by craft and not by force!

source: Homer, The Odyssey, tr. Samuel Butler (public domain), adapted
